Validations.Evidence: As they neared the edge of the clearing ahead, Torin called a halt just before stepping onto what looked like open ground. The trees parted to reveal a large, irregular space surrounded by broken stone walls and collapsed timber frames. Beyond that lay the ruins of the keep—a structure that had stood centuries ago but now served only as shelter for goblins and their victims.
